name: codex-desktop-pet
description: Add direct selected-text answers, OCR, and opt-in screen comments beside official Pets or a standalone Codex desktop pet.

interface.longDescription: Configure the native Windows helper from the plugin details page, show selected-text and OCR answers in persistent bubbles beside official Pets, keep short screen comments visually separate, or use the standalone Codex-styled companion.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex Desktop Pet on this Windows computer
Diagnose why the desktop pet cannot read my selected text
Enable selected-text questions in official Pets Quick Chat
